raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector, rolling out since 2026-01-16, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. The pipeline treats both as local, so v2 transactions are shifted 6 hours later. This pushes evening transactions into the 00:00-06:00 window and onto the next day (2026-01-19). Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time (CST, UTC-6 throughout January, no DST) restores the correct txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
